inventory: A shard of obsidian that hums with latent energy; A tattered grimoire bound in shadow-silk
party.lore: Whispers speak of Malakor; a colossal figure who dwells in forgotten places, weaving arcane energies from the very fabric of shadow. His immense power is a closely guarded secret, honed in solitude and fueled by an insatiable thirst for forbidden knowledge. He emerges only when the balance of darkness is threatened, a silent guardian of the abyss.
party.title: The Hidden Archmage
party.stat_justification: Your mastery of arcane arts and hidden knowledge marks you as a Mage.
